title: Combinatorial Models for Linear Homotopy Theories
summary: For a field $k$ of characteristic $0$, we compare $k$-linear chain complexes, semisimplicial vector spaces, augmented semisimplicial vector spaces, semicubical vector spaces, and arboreal vector spaces through small differential categorical algebras. We prove that semisimplicial modules and augmented semisimplicial modules are equivalent to appropriate chain-complex homotopy theories, both at the Gabriel--Zisman localization and the Quillen model-categorical level.
